context_requirements: Expression of AKR1B1 in the cell line
Polyol pathway flux or osmotic/aldehyde stress that aldose reductase normally counteracts
For the cholesterol-synthesis signature, an active SREBP-2/HMGCR program that can be suppressed
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed oxidative-stress or UPR genes at 24 h in any line
No suppression of the cholesterol-synthesis gene set at 24 h in any line
